about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE SHIFT FROM HELL

In 3Tower, you are the new night watchman at a graveyard like no other.

Your job? Survive the night.

But not just any night—and not just any graveyard. You're stationed at the Three Tower Cemetery, home to the so-called "problematic dead."
Three tower with ancient technology are the only thing keeping them contained.

When the towers work, all is calm.
When they don’t... things buried long ago begin to stir.

And some of them never belonged in this world to begin with.

A NEW BREED OF ATMOSPHERIC HORROR

Forget predictable jumpscares and on-rails scares.
3Tower is a first-person psychological horror game driven by unpredictable, systemic terror.

Each tower operates on unstable technology.
Each night brings new failures—blown fuses, power outages, flickering monitors—and the spirits respond dynamically. That means no scripted hauntings. If something goes wrong, the game reacts, and the horrors manifest.

No two shifts are alike.
No scare is guaranteed.
And you’re never safe.

SURVIVE OR UNCOVER THE TRUTH

You can clock in, survive your 6-hour shift from midnight to dawn, and leave.

Or…
you can investigate.

There are three alternative storylines to discover—each one revealing a different layer of the graveyard’s dark history.
Choose to obey the rules and keep your head down—or dig deeper into the origins of the towers… and the things they contain.

Some truths are better left buried.

KEY FEATURES

🕛 Real-Time Night Shift
Endure the full 6-hour shift from 12 AM to 6 AM. Every minute counts.

🔁 Three Unique Storylines
Explore alternative realities with multiple endings based on your actions, choices, and willingness to investigate.

👻 Dynamic, Unscripted Horror
No fixed scare patterns. Ghosts and anomalies react to tower failures, electrical issues, and your behavior.

💾 Save System
Uncommon for the genre—pause your progress and pick up where you left off. Perfect for those who want to dive in, bit by bit.

🖥️ High-Quality Visuals
Built for modern hardware. High-resolution textures, post-processing effects, and optimized lighting for a chilling, immersive experience.

🎧 Designed for Headphones
3D audio and ambient soundscapes that make you feel like you’re really there… even when you wish you weren’t.

DEVELOPMENT & SUPPORT

3Tower is developed by a passionate two-person team—Swen "El Dockerr"  and Jasmin Kalini —combining deep technical know-how with a strong focus on atmosphere and visual storytelling.

We’re currently in the final stretch of development.

With your support, we aim to bring 3Tower to more platforms, polish every corner of the experience, and expand the world with post-launch updates.

Can You Last the Night?

The graveyard awaits.
The towers are failing.
And something is watching.

Clock in… if you dare.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 1030 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: 3Tower is a first-person horror experience where you play as a night watchman on the graveyard shift.
